speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Eight days. Dust to the fetlock, and the dust the same colour the whole of the way.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Eight days. I have not walked as far as Carter Lane since May. You have done the road.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Oats dearer at every bait. I am not putting a price on them. Dearer is what they said, and dearer is what I paid.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Dearer is enough. I am not buying the horse's dinner from this yard.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: No rain since Aylesbury. The ruts are powder. A man breathes what the horse kicks up.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then drink before the packet. The road can stay the road.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: There is a packet from Henley Street. I have not opened it. What is in it is yours, not the ostler's.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Mine, then. Sit. I will read it where the light is, in the yard.
